# Awesome Web Toys 1000

Last updated: 2026-09-24

## Summary (English)
1,005 standalone browser toy pages covering 1,000 numbered themes in generative art, simulation, audio visualization, animation, games, and experimental browser APIs. Five alternate experiments share numbers 996-1000, with distinct directory slugs.

## Summary (Traditional Chinese)
1,005 個可獨立開啟的瀏覽器互動子項目，涵蓋 1,000 個主題編號。內容包含生成藝術、模擬、音訊視覺化、動畫、遊戲及實驗性瀏覽器 API。#996 至 #1000 各有兩個不同 slug 的主題。

## Summary (Japanese)
生成アート、シミュレーション、音声の可視化、アニメーション、ゲーム、実験的なブラウザー API を扱う、1,005 個の独立したページです。テーマ番号は 1,000 個あり、996-1000 には別のディレクトリを持つ追加作品があります。

## Key Pages (relative to this project)
- ./ : project landing page
- ./toys/001-fractal-tree/index.html : example standalone toy
- ./llms.txt : this summary
- ./sitemap.xml : full crawl map
- ./docs/audit-2026-09-24.md : quality checks and known limitations

## Runtime and verification
No package installation or build is needed to serve the toys. Use HTTPS for APIs requiring a secure context. Device and browser support vary. Automated startup checks do not certify every interaction or hardware feature.
